payload.title: Server-held model and search keys: no SSM reads from the operator machine
payload.description: monitoring_web_queries, web_search, amplify_ssm_secrets, papyrus_config, editorial_checks and papyrus_knowledge_query/services read OpenAI or Tavily keys from SSM on the laptop when an env var is missing. The server should make the model or search call and return the result.
